title: One chat message, from the Send button to the rendered answer

steps.label: User presses Send; the chat thread calls send()
Express route: POST /api/conversations/:id/messages (auth, rate limit, ownership check)
The trace row is written IN_PROGRESS before any AI call (fail closed)
Tools are bound to the session user and the read-only pool
Agent loop: up to 5 tool rounds
OpenAI chat completion with the tool definitions
Query builder adds user_id = ? and the spend rule; reads transactions
Each model and tool call is recorded (ai_model_calls, ai_tool_calls)
Answer and finished trace commit in one transaction (messages, ai_traces)
Response: user_message and assistant_message, never tool calls
The client renders the answer as safe markdown (no innerHTML)
